caption_L1: Here a bar plot is named Many people have concerns or fears for their retirement . Which , if any , of the following concerns or fears do you have ?. There is a categorical scale with Boredom on one end and The move from 'active' to 'passive' retirement at the other on the x-axis, labeled Fears and concerns. The y-axis plots Share of respondents.
caption_L2L3: The most common concern in the study group was financial hardship. Over half of the respondents were concerned about financial hardship or poor health in retirement. Very few respondents had no concerns or did not know about any concerns.
